message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The facts: Lin Moujia (林某甲) was a procurement management office specialist (专管员) in Xiangcheng district. He used his position to accept bribes from bidders (陈某甲, 陈某乙) totaling 184,000 yuan, and helped them win contracts for garbage transfer service and illegal outdoor advertising cleaning. Also 2014-2015 he used position to give insider info to Lin Mouyi (林某乙) of a bidding agency, helping them win and receiving 45,000 yuan. He later turned in 229,000 yuan. So the crime is bribery (受贿) by a state functionary. Also possibly "滥用职权" (abuse of power) because he used his position to influence bidding. In many examples, similar facts have been labeled as "受贿;滥用职权". For example earlier example with Wang1 (受贿;滥用职权). Also example with Chang2 (受贿;滥用职权). So likely both charges: 受贿 and 滥用职权. The list includes "受贿" and "滥用职权". So answer: [罪名]受贿;滥用职权<eoa>.

Check if any other charge like "职务侵占" not relevant because he didn't appropriate funds, he accepted bribes. So answer.
